notes:
CLIOPATRIA ROWS. Cliopatria has three Cao Cao shapes (197-206, 207-214, 215-223). Wikidata Q204077 is shared with the Zhou-era state of Cao (slug cao, -750..-451): that is a Wikidata mislink, the rows are different states; this dossier keeps Cliopatria's id and is not merged with cao.
SAME LAND AS THE HAN DOSSIER. The han-dynasty dossier (ea-02) draws the Han court's realm 196-220 as Cliopatria's Cao Cao shapes (it marked its own Cliopatria Han shapes wrong), so this dossier and that one describe the same cells from 196 to 220. The compiler must draw one of them; ea-02 recommended the Han, with cao-cao as events only. This dossier keeps the regime's own story: the titles (Duke of Wei 213, King of Wei 216), the conquests, and the 220 handover to the Cao Wei.
CORRECTIONS. (1) The Gongsun land (Liaodong, Xuantu, Lelang, Daifang: 657 of the 4,812 cells of the 207 shape) is not Cao Cao's; Wei takes it in September 238. (2) 204-206: Cliopatria leaves out the Yuan lands that fall in 204-205; added as new keyframes with the sibling dossiers' You Province arcs (approximate, confidence 1). (3) 215: Hanzhong added 215-218. (4) The shape stops at 220; 220-223 is cao-wei_220.
PAGE LIMITS. The Cao Cao page is a biography: it dates Ye (204), 205, 207, 213, 216 and 220 but gives no commanderies. The Liang Province (Hexi) part of the 215 shape (1,088 Gansu cells) rests on Cliopatria alone (confidence 1). No infobox area exists on the Cao Cao or Cao Wei pages, so the area check could not be made.
DISAGREEMENT. King of Wei: 216 (Cao Cao and Cao Wei pages) against 217 (Three Kingdoms page).
COUNTERPARTS WITHOUT A DOSSIER. The Wuhuan confederation (Liaoxi, 207) has none. The Heishan and Gao Gan's Bing Province are named in the sibling dossiers but not on the pages opened here.
